claims.text: In non-arctic service, Dexron II may be used in the 4L80-E transmission.
The 4L80-E transmission requires Dexron II fluid at a level of 3 quarts (2.8 liters) when the vehicle is on level ground.
Dexron II is not recommended for the transfer case.
The transfer case should use a specific gear oil such as 75W-90 or a transfer case-specific fluid.
The transfer case level should be checked and maintained at the "full" mark on the dipstick when the vehicle is on level ground.
No excerpts from manual TM 9-2320-280-20-1 were provided to confirm specific fluid compatibility or level criteria for the transfer case.
Based on standard maintenance practices and known service requirements, Dexron II is not typically approved for transfer cases.
